teaser: Bag already zipped, you are standing at checkout with one hand on the strap and the other scrolling the next itinerary. Life path 5 wants variety and freedom; INTJ wants a plan it trusts enough to leave alone. In you those pull toward the same door: a plan built for motion, not a plan that holds you still. The number keeps looking for the next scene; the mind behind the four letters keeps building the map before the scene ever opens. What is particular to you is how fast the restlessness gets organized — a five-year plan for being unpredictable.
excerpt: Six in the evening, and the party in the next room is loud enough that leaving early would not need an excuse — balloons, a cake half cut, a cousin running the music too hot.
